mapper.select: SELECT ctrt_type_cd AS "contractType",proj_stat_cd AS "status" FROM tb_pj_proj WHERE proj_id=#{id}
mapper.sql: e.exps_ym AS "month",e.exps_sn AS "sn",e.drct_exps_item_cd AS "itemCode", COALESCE(c.code_nm,e.drct_exps_item_cd) AS "itemName",e.exps_amt AS "amount",e.rmrk AS "memo",e.reg_dttm AS "registeredAt"
FROM tb_pj_drct_exps e LEFT JOIN tb_sy_code c ON c.code_grp_id='DRCT_EXPS_ITEM' AND c.code=e.drct_exps_item_cd
mapper.select: SELECT WHERE e.proj_id=#{id} ORDER BY e.reg_dttm DESC,e.exps_ym DESC,e.exps_sn DESC
SELECT WHERE e.proj_id=#{id} AND e.exps_ym=#{month} AND e.exps_sn=#{sn}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tb_sy_code WHERE code_grp_id='DRCT_EXPS_ITEM' AND code=#{code} AND use_yn='Y' AND del_yn='N')

SELECT GREATEST( COALESCE((SELECT max(exps_sn) FROM tb_pj_drct_exps WHERE proj_id=#{id} AND exps_ym=#{month}),0), COALESCE((SELECT max(substring(trgt_key FROM length(#{id}||':'||#{month}||':')+1)::integer) FROM tb_sy_chg_hist WHERE trgt_tbl_nm='TB_PJ_DRCT_EXPS' AND left(trgt_key,length(#{id}||':'||#{month}||':'))=#{id}||':'||#{month}||':' AND substring(trgt_key FROM length(#{id}||':'||#{month}||':')+1) ~ '^[0-9]{1,5}$'),0))
mapper.update: LOCK TABLE tb_cl_close IN SHARE MODE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tb_pj_drct_exps WHERE proj_id=#{id} AND exps_ym=#{month} AND exps_sn=#{sn}
